nodes.label: File-Based Routing
nodes.rationale: TanStack Start uses file-based routing; every .tsx in src/routes is a route. Next.js/Remix conventions avoided.

nodes.label: Dynamic Route (users/$id.tsx to /users/:id)
nodes.rationale: Dynamic params use bare $ prefix, no curly braces.

nodes.label: Root Layout (__root.tsx app shell)
nodes.rationale: Only root layout is __root.tsx; wraps every page, preserve Outlet. Next.js app/layout.tsx rejected.

nodes.label: Next.js/Remix Conventions - Avoided
nodes.rationale: src/pages, _app/index.tsx, app/layout.tsx disallowed to keep TanStack Start routing pure.
